description: Fir Extract FIR 58/2023, PS Division No.4 at PS Division No.4 (Ludhiana): Murder / Attempt to Murder

metadata.text: [Public record · High Court of Punjab and Haryana, CRM-M-21596-2025, order dated 2025-07-31 · names pseudonymised] Facts as recorded in the order: I hereby state that I am resident of above mentioned address and I do job at [Name W1] Designer Store, College Road, Ludhiana. My parental house is in Street No. 2, [Name W2] Nagar, [Name W3], Ludhiana and we are six brothers-sisters. [Person X3] is my maternal aunt's (masi) son who is residing with my mother-father since 1 childhood and my mother-father looks after him. [Person X3] used to talk with one girl of locality namely [Person X1]. On dt. 17.06.2023 [Person X1] alongwith her mother was going in e rickshaw and one youth namely [Person X2] forcibly got stopped the erickshaw by stopping his motorcycle in front of e-rickshaw inside the locality itself near Gurdwara Sahib and forcibly took the mobile phone of [Person X1] from her. At that time [Person X1] was talking with [Person X3] on her mobile phone and [Person X2] took mobile number of [Person X3] from [Person X1]'s mobile phone and since that day he started making phone calls and started giving threats to scare him. [Person X3] had gone to Goa on dt. 18.06.2023. Today phone call of [Person X2] came to [Person X3] that [Person X1] is my friend, you back off, else I shall kill you. [Person X3] said to him that currently I have come at Gos, after coming back I shaالtalk to you. Whereupon, [Person X2] said that if you do not come back today then I shall kill any member of your family. Court proceedings: petition for regular bail by [Accused A1], [Accused A2]; outcome: Dismissed. The order mentions criminal antecedents without listing them.
